tool-quick-connect.title: Add tool
tool-quick-connect.intro: Choose a tool to read its registered node's inventory and fill in the configuration automatically.
tool-quick-connect.catalog_hint: Implemented execution entrypoints are shown here. Find other clients and setup guidance in the tool catalog.
tool-quick-connect.reading_nodes: Checking this project's authorized execution nodes…
tool-quick-connect.no_node: This project has no connected execution node yet
tool-quick-connect.no_node_hint: Register and connect a project identity for this computer or a remote node first. A real inventory report can then fill in the tool configuration.
tool-quick-connect.unreported: This node has not reported tools. Connect the node or complete Advanced setup, then read again.
tool-quick-connect.expired: The inventory has expired. Read the node's latest report again.
tool-quick-connect.no_matching: This node has not reported this tool entrypoint. Check its installation and node configuration, or use Advanced setup.
tool-quick-connect.unavailable: Configuration “{{command}}” cannot be registered yet. Check installation, protocol and workspace configuration on the execution node.
tool-quick-connect.worktree_write: Writes permitted in a separate worktree
tool-quick-connect.name: Configuration name
tool-quick-connect.register_hint: Registration keeps the configuration paused. Explicitly enable it for future dispatch. A probe does not confirm model authentication or task success.
tool-quick-connect.paused_hint: Registration keeps the configuration paused. Review its node and permissions, then explicitly enable it. Dispatch will check them again.
tool-quick-connect.local_hint: The desktop app can also check whether the selected tool is installed on this computer.
tool-quick-connect.local_failed: The local installation check did not complete. Retry or use Advanced setup.
tool-quick-connect.local_boundary: An installation check does not connect a node, register a configuration or enable dispatch.
tool-quick-connect.local_launch_pending: The tool was found, but its launch method needs Advanced setup. This check does not register or enable the tool.
tool-quick-connect.next: Choose a tool and configure automatically
tool-quick-connect.next_hint: Use a connected node's fresh inventory, review the configuration, then register and explicitly enable it.
tool-quick-connect.saved_node_missing: The previously selected node {{node}} is currently unavailable. Check that node or explicitly choose another.
tool-quick-connect.saved_configuration_m: The previously selected configuration {{command}} is absent from the current available report. Check the original node configuration or explicitly choose another.
